name: avatar-group
purpose: Row of overlapping avatars for the people on a record, with the overflow collapsed into '+N'. A named group; each avatar is named by its person and the overflow chip is announced as 'N more'.
whenToUse: Members, assignees, or viewers of a record, project, or document.
Compact presence of several people in a header or card.
whenNotToUse: A list the user must read in full or act on: use a list or a table.
responsive: Inline row; avatars overlap by a quarter of their size. It does not wrap; lower max for narrow containers.
rtl: Overlap and order follow the inline direction.
theme: Avatars use the Avatar tokens; each is ringed in color-surface. The '+N' chip uses color-text on color-surface with a color-border-strong boundary. Forced-colors mode removes the rings (Avatar draws CanvasText boundaries).
security: Each item is validated as Avatar options (safe image sources only). Names are rendered with textContent.
dataHandling: Only the avatars' img elements load their src (no-referrer). No persistence, other network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: Up to 10,000 items accepted; at most max (up to 50) avatars are rendered.

limitations: The people behind '+N' are not listed; show the full list elsewhere (for example in a dialog) when it matters.
unsupported: Clickable avatars or chip (wrap the group in a control that opens the full list).
antiPatterns: Using a group as the only place where the full member list is available.
